description: This file defines an abstract class 'ExternalAPIBase' that provides a base implementation for external API integrations within the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for loading authorization data, checking login status, posting data via cURL, managing connectors, and handling callback URL formatting. The class implements the 'ExternalAPIPlugin' interface and serves as a foundation for subclasses that interact with external APIs.

classes.name: ExternalAPIBase
classes.description: An abstract class serving as a base implementation for external API integrations within SuiteCRM, providing common methods for authorization, data posting, connector management, and URL formatting.

methods.name: loadEAPM
methods.description: Loads authorization data from an EAPM bean and initializes account credentials based on the authentication method.

methods.name: checkLogin
methods.description: Checks if a valid login/session exists for the external API, optionally loading EAPM data.

methods.name: quickCheckLogin
methods.description: Performs a quick validation of login status based on existing EAPM data.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves a specified property value if set.

methods.name: logOff
methods.description: Handles logoff procedures; currently a stub returning true.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if the API supports the specified authentication method.

methods.name: postData
methods.description: Posts data to a specified URL using cURL, with support for proxy settings and logging.

methods.name: getConnector
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the connector source associated with this API.

methods.name: getConnectorParam
methods.description: Fetches a parameter value from the associated connector.

methods.name: formatCallbackURL
methods.description: Formats a callback URL by appending request-specific parameters related to OAuth callback handling.

methods.name: getErrorStringFromCode
methods.description: Returns a translatable error string based on an error code.

methods.name: isMimeDetectionAvailable
methods.description: Checks if MIME detection functions are available in the environment.
